item: {"addr": "0x1407c3fc0", "comment": "Replaces the knowledge's DetectionState (+0x20) and clears RequestedAt (+0x44 = -FLT_MAX). Skipping it leaves the request queued forever: 42712 never re-queues and 42702 returns the old state at any age (coop HookUpdateDetectionState, stealth.md)"}

{"addr": "0x1407c58e3", "comment": "the computed level (-1000 when skipped), LOS seen (+0x15), into the pooled state; 42704 installs it on the knowledge"}
{"addr": "0x1407c6600", "comment": "DetectionState: +0x10 level, +0x14 ?, +0x15 seen (counted by 41408), +0x16, +0x18 time seen, +0x28 time detected, +0x38 UpdatedAt"}
